findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: avenity_get_competitor_landscape, avenity_score_business, avenity_book_consultation · Public sink: avenity_get_opportunity_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: avenity_get_competitor_landscape, avenity_score_business, avenity_book_consultation · Public sink: avenity_get_opportunity_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
